definitions.short: Achab , the name of a king of Israel and of a prophet at Babylon
definitions.full: H256. Achab אַחְאָב 91 proper name, masculine Ahab ( father's brother ; = אחיאב Nö ZMG 1886, 172 , Ἀχίαβος was a nephew of Herod; compare like name in Syriac, given ob maximum cum parte suo similitudinem , BarHebr Chron. Ecclesiastes 2.23 compare LCB 1879, 1339 . In many cases, however, the meaning of proper names compared with אח is dubious, & perfect consistency, especially in comparison with compounds of אָב , seems impossible; compare remark below אביאל and further We Skizzen, iii. 1 f , Dl Pr. cap. vi ) — אַחְאָב 1Kin 16:28 +; וּכְאֶחָב Jer 29:22 — 1 son of Omri, king of Isr . 1Kin 16:28-29 , 18:1-2 , 3 ; 20:2 , 13 , 14 41 t. 1Kings, 27 t. 2Kings, 14 t. 2 Chronicles; Micah 6:16 . 2 false prophet, time of Jeremiah . Jer 29:21-22 ,. אַחָב see אַחְאָב .
definitions.rootNote: once (by contraction) אֶחָב (Jeremiah 29:22); from 251 and 1 ; brother (i.e. friend) of (his) father;
